integrity: The proof derives exact vertex and edge code forms from the complete multipartite metric and classifies every possible complement of a mixed resolving set. A separate exhaustive checker tests all vertex and edge distance codes directly and reproduces the corrected K_{3,3,5} value.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The complete-bipartite minimum-value formula is prior work and is not claimed as new.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
A later erratum or differently phrased correction not found by the searches remains a literature risk.
title: Mixed metric dimension of complete multipartite graphs: a correction and full classification
